observations: Three real-Claude runs started at the same time on this pod (3 claude processes plus 9 hooks at once) failed 3 of 12 moments, carrying a saved list or the failure line. Serial runs passed 12 of 12. Under that load the 150 ms least wait is the designed trade between the time bound and freshness.

The bound with a slow host: an 820 ms start-up plus Dispatch hanging held the hook 1.17-1.35 s. The reading part is at most 150 + 50 ms after the hook's code begins, and the rest is Bun's start-up and bundle load. This is the implementer's stated deviation.

Scope: a person's reply in any non-ask thread on a document now reaches every session the document credits, also as an Envoy delivery, not only in the list. Another agent session's reply in that thread was still not routed to the document's writer (seq 7 went to the document topic only).
